summary: User review rejected the P16 advanced prototype. The issue is product-model correctness, not only visual detail: application was still partially treated as an internal business-module concept, while the project requires application to be a peer of system and flow for system-to-system, external, and flow/module capability invocation management. The prototype also missed mandatory mainstream backend interaction gates: collapsible navigation, consistent drawer-based create/edit/detail, advanced filters, column configuration, full page/field/data/export/application permission expression, and multi-system login routing. The current P15/P16 frontend and prototypes remain non-final and must not be packaged as a usable system.
